# `starling`

Run STARLING segmentation-aware probabilistic phenotyping from IMC AnnData marker expression

- Wrapper: [`job_starling.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_starling.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_starling`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.starling_analysis`

## Inputs

- starling.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- starling.initial_label_obs or general.population_obs_primary when starling.initial_clustering_method=User
- adata.X by default, or starling.use_layer if set; optional starling.marker_include/marker_exclude

## Outputs

- starling.output_adata_path (default general.anndata_path)
- general.qc_folder/starling.qc_output_subdir (default QC/Starling_QC)

## Configuration

- general, starling, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl starling
```
